name: Beijing Capital Development Co., Ltd.
summary: Beijing Capital Development Co., Ltd. operates as a real estate development company in China. It is also involved in property management and real estate finance activities; renewal and renovation of old urban areas; and operation and promotion of long-term rental apartments, office buildings, and other formats. The company was founded in 1993 and is based in Beijing, China. Beijing Capital Development Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Beijing Capital Development Holding (Group) Co., Ltd.
